text: Build a Rust app to replace the custom seedbox and media-sync scripts in a formal, contained system

Modules in mind: remote seedbox config (port forwarding?), install/remove *arr/usenet/torrent, configure apps and directories, bootstrap a local media path, invoke CLI LLM agents for title research and media debug
Session grounded in live tree under ~/videos, apply-stack.py, media-sync, encode_h264.py, reclaim, SEEDBOX.md, and prior seedbox research
started First Principles Thinking
Bedrock: two machines, one operator; seedbox is rented working memory; home disk is the archive and the playback surface
Bedrock: *arr is a grabber, not the library of record; local filesystem plus Jellyfin is the library of record
Bedrock: installers mutate files and are not desired state; panel rewrites nginx; Usenet is deletable after copy; torrents are not while seeding
Bedrock: SSH is the trust boundary and the pipe; nginx URL-bases already are the UI edge; naming is a Jellyfin contract; Chrome/TV need H.264 8-bit
Model the world as two Stores (RemoteBuffer, LocalArchive) plus an optional Grabber; the app is a reconciler, not a script runner
Title identity is TMDB/TVDB/MBID plus kind; folder names are a rendered view of identity, not the identity
A desired-state document is the only user-facing config; every flag in apply-stack.py becomes a typed field
Connection is {host, port, user, auth}; SeedIt4Me port 2097 is an instance, not architecture
Talk to the seedbox only through an SSH capability: exec, rsync/sftp, optional local-forward — never assume a public WebUI
Port-forward is a debug lens (mediaops ui sonarr) that lasts for a session, not how daemons talk
Install is a Provider trait: SwizzinBox, DockerCompose, AlreadyThere; v1 ships Swizzin plus AlreadyThere only
Version pins are first-class (Lidarr 2.14.5 / glibc) so upgrade is a conscious transaction, never a panel click
EdgeInvariant: bind 127.0.0.1 + url_base + Host $host + Forms auth; reconcile fails if any of those drift
PathSchema is a versioned grammar that compiles to PathBufs; AGENTS.md is generated from it so docs cannot lie
Plan is a first-class artifact with actions: Copy, Skip, Review, Unmonitor, DeleteRemote, Encode, Reclaim
Copy is always remote to staging .partial, verify, then atomic install into a schema path
Never walk torrent save paths; torrent files are not archive files
After Copy of usenet complete: DeleteRemote; after Copy of a library hardlink: leave the torrent
Holds are a typed queue with Approve, Reject, Research — not a folder Jellyfin might ingest
EncodePolicy(codec, depth, container, hdr) yields Keep, NvencH264, or Refuse; HDR/DV refuse-to-encode is a law
ResourceBudget lives in config: max_copy_gib, min_free_gib, max_nvenc, lock — no magic numbers in source
ReclaimPolicy is constraints (private, seeding, imported) times an objective (free space percent), replacing leftover timers
Discover API keys from remote config.xml and sabnzbd.ini at runtime; never store the masked ********
Indexers and download clients are sets; adding a duplicate is a conflict, not an append
GrabPolicy is data (delay, quality, indexer priority, client priority) applied via *arr API, not clicks
BootstrapLocal creates schema dirs, watermarks, systemd user timer OnUnitInactiveSec, ffmpeg/NVENC probe, and refuses if disk is below watermark
AgentTask is {prompt_template, inputs, output_schema, timeout, cwd sandbox, binary} — an LLM is a subprocess, not a brain in-process
Agents get read-only probes by default (ffprobe, ls, *arr GET); Apply is an explicit grant
CLI is the API; TUI and completions are skins; every capability is a clap subcommand
Crate graph: mediaops-core, mediaops-ssh, mediaops-arr, mediaops-sync, mediaops-encode, mediaops-agent, mediaops-cli
Test with cassette fixtures of *arr JSON and directory trees; never require the live box for unit tests
Jobs have state machines; timers only start make-progress-on-ready-jobs — no overlapping hope-cron
Bulk copy uses its own SSH TCP stream and never ControlMaster multiplexing
Crash safety: *.partial is sacred; empty-dir prune never deletes partials
The library of record can run with grabber=None: sync a folder, name it, encode it — *arr is optional
Idempotent apply: running apply twice is a no-op if Edge, Grab, and Paths already match
Local sqlite maps TitleId to path to inode/hash so identity survives renames
Read ~/.ssh/config Host seedbox instead of inventing another host alias format
Custom formats (Prefer H.264, HEVC last, 10-bit last, AV1 last) are versioned policy packs the app applies
Prowlarr app URLs must include url_base; doctor checks /prowlarr/{id}/ not /{id}/
Before remote library delete, query qBit for that path; if seeding, skip — a typed guard, not a comment
Music-first uncapped then videos under budget is a job-priority law in the planner, not a hardcode in pull()
Round-trip test: parse(render(id)) == id, so year lives in folder and file the same way
started Reverse Brainstorming
Failure: app and SeedIt4Me panel fight over nginx every minute. Inverse: detect panel fingerprint, freeze apply unless --repair-edge, alert
Failure: commit API keys to git. Inverse: zero secrets in git; keys are remote-discovered or in a keyring
Failure: multiplex 200GiB rsync through ControlMaster. Inverse: dedicated stream per bulk copy, and lint-fail if RSYNC_RSH has ControlPath
Failure: delete qBit data after copy. Inverse: torrent delete belongs to reclaim, never to sync
Failure: copy from torrents/incomplete. Inverse: allowlist of remote roots in schema; unknown paths are errors
Failure: auto-approve every hold. Inverse: holds require a human or an agent recommendation with a confidence floor
Failure: fire 8 NVENC jobs. Inverse: hardware probe sets concurrency; this box caps at 3
Failure: click Lidarr Update. Inverse: package updates are pinned; upgrade lidarr explains glibc and can refuse
Failure: two-way sync that mirrors local deletes to the seedbox. Inverse: one-way pull; remote delete only for surplus after local proof
Failure: give the LLM ssh root. Inverse: agent runtime is a capability token (ReadFs, ProbeMedia, ArrGet, ArrPost, SshExecAllowlist)
Failure: forward *arr to 0.0.0.0 on the home LAN. Inverse: default forward is localhost-only and ephemeral
Failure: allow spaces in names because Jellyfin is smart. Inverse: schema parser is a gate; install refuses
Failure: add _incoming as a Jellyfin library. Inverse: bootstrap writes a libraries manifest that lists only movies, series, music
Failure: add NZBgeek a second time. Inverse: Prowlarr indexer apply is upsert-by-name with a set diff
Failure: paste ******** into Test. Inverse: never display secrets; Test uses the discovered key; UI says key present
Failure: transcode Avatar DV to H.264. Inverse: HDR/DV and 2160p remux are a Keep-forever class
Failure: OnCalendar=hourly overlapping runs. Inverse: oneshot plus OnUnitInactiveSec plus flock, all three
Failure: ignore the 256 GiB watermark. Inverse: preflight fail if a copy would breach watermark
Failure: one giant filename regex. Inverse: composable parsers (movie, episode, track) with explicit reject bins (needs-split, needs-year)
Failure: TUI is the only UI. Inverse: TUI is optional; cron and systemd must call the CLI
Failure: abstract Ultra.cc plus Swizzin plus QuickBox in v1. Inverse: one provider well; others are unimplemented traits with tests
Failure: hot-reload config mid-rsync. Inverse: config is snapshotted at plan start; changes wait for the next job
Failure: trust *arr file-exists as local exists. Inverse: local filesystem is source of truth; *arr is told to unmonitor
Failure: let agents change quality profiles casually. Inverse: GrabPolicy changes are explicit commands with a diff
Failure: exit 0 on lock conflict silently. Inverse: lock conflict is a distinct exit code plus a skip-with-reason log line
Failure: custom Rust TCP file protocol in v1. Inverse: shell out to rsync; maybe librsync later
Failure: identity equals path string. Inverse: identity lives in sqlite of TitleId, path, inode, hash
Failure: a wizard that only works once. Inverse: every wizard step is a reconcile of desired state
Failure: copy videos first so music never arrives. Inverse: keep music-first as a planner priority, generalize later to a wants queue
Failure: follow symlinks into torrent trees. Inverse: walk never follows symlinks off the allowlist
Failure: per-file SFTP for 80 GiB. Inverse: rsync --partial on one stream
Failure: year in the file but not the folder. Inverse: round-trip parse(render(id)) == id as a CI test
Failure: dump the entire library tree into the LLM every research call. Inverse: agents get a title dossier (ffprobe, nfo, *arr payload, neighbors), not the universe
Failure: bind *arr to star and hope. Inverse: bind address is part of EdgeInvariant
Failure: auto-upgrade 1080p to 4k remux when disk is bored. Inverse: upgrade is an explicit per-title profile class (HD vs Ultra-HD)
Failure: parse scene tags into the library name. Inverse: strip list is schema, with tests from real sins like REPACJ
Failure: run encode on the seedbox CPU. Inverse: encode is a home-GPU capability; seedbox is dumb disk plus pipe
Failure: require root on the seedbox for every command. Inverse: root only for nginx and package install; everything else is user-level API
Failure: replace rsync with rclone copyto to a second cloud. Inverse: the job is home archive, not a third copy
Failure: let doctor --repair run unattended from a public laptop. Inverse: write repairs need a local confirm flag or a pin; scheduled doctor is read-only
Failure: store desired-state only on the seedbox. Inverse: desired-state lives with the home repo; the box is disposable
Failure: chatty TUI that blocks the timer. Inverse: progress is structured log plus optional TUI attach
started Job to Be Done
The user is not hiring a seedbox control panel; they are hiring tonight-playable media, a quiet box, and a way to ask why when something is weird
Job tonight-on-the-TV: watch TITLE ensures monitored, grabbed, pulled, encoded if needed, then prints a Jellyfin URL
Job I-just-bought-a-disk: bootstrap /mnt/storage/videos creates schema, timer, watermarks, and generated docs
Job panel-ate-nginx: seedbox doctor plus seedbox repair edge is the one command you remember
Job why-is-disk-full: seedbox df with a reclaim preview ranked by ratio, private, age
Job why-isnt-this-in-Jellyfin: why TITLE traces grab to import to hold to pull to encode to library
Job is-this-the-theatrical-cut: agent research returns a dossier (year, edition, runtime vs ffprobe)
Job Chrome-stutters: playback TITLE classifies keep/encode against client profiles and can enqueue NVENC
Job dont-get-banned: seed-goal dashboard; reclaim never touches private-under-goal
Job I-dont-want-to-SSH-to-click: all *arr settings as seedbox apply from a file you can read in git
Job new-machine: export desired-state plus title index; import bootstraps layout even before files exist
Job split-this-season-pack: needs-split is a workflow with an agent, not a pile of files
Job I-already-have-Relayer: album identity is MBID, not folder year, so remasters do not look like missing albums
Job run-while-Im-asleep: systemd oneshot is the product; the TUI is for Saturday
Job tell-me-what-will-happen: plan is the default verb; run is plan plus apply
Job I-rejected-Homework: Reject is a first-class event — never pull this release, let *arr try another
Job I-approved-Hearts: I looked at it, put it in the library, trust me — promote from the hold queue
Job research-this-filename: agent maps a scene name to TitleId without downloading
Job debug-this-mkv: agent gets ffprobe plus mediainfo plus a Jellyfin client profile and answers Direct Play vs transcode
Job set-up-a-friend: same binary, different desired-state file — cloneable ops, not a SaaS
Job feel-safe-deleting-seedbox-media: show local hash proof before remote delete
Job dont-fill-the-spinning-disk-tonight: --max-gb with a live remaining-home-disk figure
Job use-the-Ada-GPU-for-good: encode queue is a visible, pausable job, not a surprise after sync
Job when-Im-away-dont-break: scheduled doctor is read-only; write repairs need a pin or flag
Job forget-Swizzin: success metric is days without SSHing to the panel
Job I-hired-the-agent-so-I-dont-open-12-tabs: research and debug as subcommands that shell out to claude, codex, or grok
Job make-the-junk-drawer-official: _ops and _incoming become app-managed state dirs with a schema, still not libraries
Job one-binary-on-PATH: mediaops via cargo; no Python venv, no PYTHONPATH
Job cockpit: TUI panes for disk, queue, holds, last plan, agent output
Job let-me-script-it: --json on every command so other tools can compose
Job teach-the-next-agent: generated AGENTS.md plus schema so coding agents do not invent spaces in filenames
Job music-this-week-not-more-Futurama: generalize music-first into a wants queue the planner honors
Job dont-make-me-remember-port-2097: import SSH config Host seedbox
Job if-rsync-dies-at-90-continue: resume is the job — partials plus rsync --partial
Job tell-arr-I-have-it: reconcile after a manual copy, because truth drifted
Job I-want-to-see-the-diff: apply and repair print unified diffs of ini, xml, and nginx before writing
Job pick-an-LLM-per-task: research can be a web-using agent; debug-media can be a local-file agent; the app only cares about the schema out
Job I-moved-the-library: bootstrap --relocate rewrites schema roots, systemd, and the title index paths
Job show-me-holds-on-the-phone: status --json served only on localhost, or just ssh mediaops status — no extra daemon if possible
started Failure Analysis
Panel nginx Host rewrite: what broke is 302 to localhost after a panel install; lesson: treat panel as an untrusted writer and hash nginx app confs for drift
Turn EdgeRepair into one transaction that dry-runs a diff, then applies fix-nginx plus apply-stack as a single unit
After any box install or upgrade, automatically queue an edge check before declaring success
ControlMaster starvation: 200GiB rsync collapsed other SSH; lesson: SSH module is two clients — mux for API/exec, dedicated TCP for bulk
HEVC-MP4 Chrome dropped frames: encode scan is movies/**/*.mp4 HEVC10 only; make series-skip an explicit rule, not an accident
Encode is a reversible transaction: write .converting, replace, move original to backup-hevc-originals; never delete until replace succeeds
Playback matrix in config: client profiles (Chrome, TV, Shield) times codec yields keep, encode, or refuse
importBlocked forever: Hold is a product feature showing the *arr message, ffprobe, and approve/reject/research — never leave blocked NZBs posing as library
Lidarr glibc: a compatibility matrix per provider OS; upgrade consults it and can freeze updates in config
Masked API key Test fail: secret hygiene UX is presence-boolean, rotate command, never echo
Duplicate indexer: desired indexers as a set with priority; apply deletes extras
SEEDBOX.md vs code scan-path lie: generate docs from PathSchema; mediaops docs render writes the human markdown from the same structs as the walker
decide_item skip vs upgrade: upgrade policy is never | if-better-profile | if-user-marked-UHD; default never, matching current skip
Surplus is not skip: surplus means remote can go after local proof
Music remaster year: Relayer 1974 vs Relayer.(2013) is a documented identity rule, not a clever year compare
REPACJ leftover: scene-tag stripper has tests from real library sins (REPACJ, REPACK, PROPER)
mediaops library lint finds names that violate schema, including leftover scene tags and Season 1 folders
Partial left in from-seedbox: crash recovery command sync resume lists .partial and continues; GC never deletes them
Lock: machine-global flock with pid, started_at, and command in the lockfile; status shows who holds it
Encode 8 concurrent: NVENC semaphore from a GPU probe, never a hardcoded 8
_incoming as library: doctor warns if Jellyfin libraries include _incoming or _ops
Timer semantics: OnUnitInactiveSec is the only v1 scheduler adapter; wrap systemd-user, do not invent cron math
Hardlink seeding delete: typed guard querying qBit before any remote library unlink
Workspace /home/coto/work/dev/media-sync is empty while the live app lives under ~/videos/_incoming: the new crate is the repo of record, and the live tree becomes a deploy target
Quality profile custom-format scores drifting after panel: treat CF packs as desired state and re-PUT them on apply
SABnzbd category mismatch: categories tv/movies/music are schema, asserted on SAB and on each *arr client
qBit DHT/PeX/LSD left on: privacy and tracker policy is an invariant checked by doctor
Daily seedbox-reclaim.timer leftover no-op: reclaim is either a real policy with a dry-run or it is removed, never a silent timer
Needs-review music sitting (Daft Punk Homework, The Who, Yes): the hold queue needs a TUI/CLI inbox with age, size, and *arr reason or it becomes a junk drawer again
House.of.the.Dragon S02E07 REPACJ: lint-on-install would have stripped or rejected; install is the quality gate, not a later mop
encode_h264.py does not convert H.264 10-bit even though AGENTS.md says to: policy packs must drive the encoder or docs will keep lying
Failure of scripts as a genre: they encode tribal knowledge in comments; the app encodes it in types, tests, and generated docs

Port-forward as a product failure mode: if the home app talks to forwarded ports, a laptop sleep kills apply; therefore apply must be SSH-exec on the box or HTTP through an SSH tunnel the process owns
LLM agent failure: unbounded context of the whole library; fix is the dossier pattern plus a max-bytes budget per task
LLM agent failure: it invents a rename with spaces; fix is the agent may propose, the schema parser is the only writer
LLM agent failure: it calls *arr POST because the prompt was vague; fix is capability tokens and a dry-run default
Single-binary failure: wrapping rsync, ffmpeg, ssh, systemd, jellyfin-ffmpeg means the app is an orchestrator — declare those as external runtime deps with probes, do not vendor them
